author: iabeer

text:
I had the great pleasure of visiting the Alhambra with my family on Thursday, July 17, 2025 with an exceptional guide: Mohamed, originally from Syria. His passion for history, his pedagogy and the richness of his explanations made this visit unforgettable during which we took quite a few photos and videos. Thanks to him, each place came to life through fascinating stories. I highly recommend this guided tour to anyone wishing to discover the Alhambra with depth and emotion. A huge thank you to Mohamed for this precious moment!
